text: The frontier review can ACCEPT on attempt 1 and still delete the earned inline internal link: the _final.md came back with zero [text](/path) links on the 2026-11-17 double-count run, which article_shape would have held at the push. Grep the final for '\[[^]]*\](/' and restore the link before running gate, not after.

A research publisher's own correction release is the strongest available primary for a data-integrity story — it names the mechanism, the affected count and the republished figures — and it dates itself by its download filenames (e.g. 20261107_...pdf) when the page body carries no publication date; read those filenames before putting the row in the signals file.

verify.sh's calendar rule measures the WHOLE row (length($0) > 900), not the notes cell the prompt describes: with the five-column prefix at ~150 chars, the notes cell must be ~745 chars or the build reds on your own row. Count the assembled row, not the cell.

check_social_voice.mjs scans every file in context/drafts/, so a verdict-framing phrase repaired in the _final.md but left in the sibling _draft.md still reds the repo on your own run — patch the draft and the final together, then re-run the voice gate before verify.sh.
